description: Routing < <= > >= in guards to Kernel is refused today: 'guard helper cycle detected: </2 -> </2', because the last clause is 'compare(left, right) < 0' and a guard helper is reified without argument types. With typed selection the inner integer comparison picks the integer head. Then PatternGuardBinOp::{Lt, LtEq, Gt, GtEq} leave the three evaluators.
title: A guard helper is selected by argument types, so ordering operators in guards can go through Kernel
